records.title: xRAG: Extreme Context Compression for Retrieval-augmented Generation with One Token
records.reason: retrieved document全文の代わりに既存dense retrieval embeddingを1 tokenへprojectしてLLMへ入力し、RAGのcontext長・FLOPs・CUDA timeを直接削減する推論効率化なので対象。
records.body_check: fulltext_review: arXiv本文§1–5を確認。retriever document embeddingを2-layer modality projectorでLLM representationへ写像し、通常約175 tokenのretrieved documentを1 tokenへ圧縮。Mistral-7B/Mixtral-8x7Bと6 knowledge-intensive tasksで評価し、uncompressed RAG比で平均FLOPs 3.53x削減、CUDA time平均1.64x高速化。retriever/LLMは凍結しprojectorのみ学習。
